thesis: The episode explores the potential of Ladder, a startup aiming to unlock latent supply in the fitness industry by connecting personal trainers with unused time to consumers seeking affordable coaching. The host, who is an investor in the company, frames the discussion as an experiment in aggressive immersion into the venture capital and startup sectors rather than providing specific investment advice.
